vetSays.line: 🛡️ Easton, Bridget, Marie, Fatima and Aria met them at the door — 5 put down. Easton, Bridget, Marie, Fatima, Aria are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Molly just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Molly, Bridget, Adriano, Fatima and Aria met them at the door — 5 put down. Molly, Bridget, Adriano, Aria are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marie just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Molly just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fatima just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aria just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Molly, Fatima and Aria met them at the door — 3 put down. Molly, Fatima, Aria are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Molly just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down The Eulogy... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mateo and Pavel met them at the door — 2 put down. Mateo is hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Aria taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Aria drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Pavel: "European Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mateo met them at the door — 1 put down. Mateo is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mateo, Aki and Raul met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Mateo, Aki, Raul are hurt.
Mateo: "European Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
